title: Seismic supports.
officialText: The determination as to whether seismic requirements apply to an alteration shall be made in accordance with the 1968 Building Code and interpretations by the department relating to such determinations. Any applicable seismic loads and requirements shall be permitted to be determined in accordance with Chapter 16 of this code or the 1968 Building Code and Reference Standard RS 9-6 of such code.
